values: 30002821 / OWR-13498-011 — Propp–Kenyon, Disk packings of maximum area (OWR 13/2015, Problem 7, printed p.722); https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46561#page=62

Alper Ferudun (Mercury Software GmbH), The Ford-Circle Packing Has Maximum Area: An Answer to a Question of Propp and Kenyon, v1.1, 2026-09-30. Existing external publication; credit is Ferudun, not Alec Kriebel authorship or a new publication from this sweep. Complete greedy packing of the bounded gap between the x-axis and unit disks centered at (±1,1) attains maximum area pi*(zeta(3)/zeta(4)-1) among all countable positive-radius, pairwise interior-disjoint packings whose disks touch the line. Boundary disks excluded; tangencies allowed. Also proved for any two tangent positive-radius boundary disks and sums of r^alpha for alpha>1, plus the stated positive scale superpositions. No uniqueness, nontangent-boundary, non-line-tangent or arbitrary-weight extension; greedy power sums diverge for alpha<=1. Fresh original-source and full twelve-page proof audit found no missing mathematical step. Published PDF, source ZIP and verification report verified by size/MD5/SHA256; all 102 ZIP entries CRC checked; 45 source programs statically inventoried, no author program executed. Independent supplementary checker passed 702059 checks in ordinary, -O and -OO modes; the universal theorem rests on the written proof. AI-assisted unrefereed preprint and internal AI review; no conventional human peer review, formal certification, independent discovery or exhaustive historical-priority claim. No duplicate Zenodo upload. Original PR https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1217 ; version https://zenodo.org/records/23049959 ; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23049224, earlier v1.0 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23049225.
